title: Linear Modelling of Microbiome Data
description: Nextflow pipeline for CODA-GLMNET penalized regression and best-subset regression on microbiome feature tables.

input_output_options.title: Input / Output Options
input_output_options.description: Paths to input data and output directory.

feature_table.description: Path to feature table. Supported formats: BIOM (.biom), TSV (.tsv/.txt), or GTDB taxonomy-annotated TSV.

meta_table.description: Path to sample metadata CSV. First column must be sample IDs.

taxonomy_table.description: Path to taxonomy TSV (required for tsv/gtdb input formats). First column: featureID; second column: semicolon-separated taxonomy string.

input_format.description: Format of the feature table. 'biom': QIIME2/BIOM format. 'tsv': tab-separated with QIIME2-style prefixes. 'gtdb': tab-separated with GTDB-style prefixes.

output_dir.description: Directory where all output CSVs will be written.

label.description: Label prefix applied to all output file names.

filtering_options.title: Filtering Options
filtering_options.description: Parameters for filtering samples and features before modelling.

min_library_size.description: Minimum sequencing depth (library size) required per sample. Samples below this threshold are removed.

exclude_column.description: Metadata column name used to filter out samples. Used together with exclude_values.

exclude_values.description: Comma-separated list of values in exclude_column that should be removed from the dataset.

grouping_options.title: Grouping Options
grouping_options.description: Parameters defining how samples are split into groups for per-group modelling.

groups_column.description: Metadata column that defines the grouping variable. Each unique value becomes a separate group for modelling. If empty and groups_paste_columns is empty, all samples are treated as one group ('All').

groups_paste_columns.description: Comma-separated list of metadata columns to concatenate (paste) to form the grouping variable. Takes precedence over groups_column if set.

coda_taxon_rank.description: Taxonomy level to aggregate features to before modelling.

coda_normalisation.description: Normalisation method applied to the feature table before CODA-GLMNET. TSS+CLR (recommended for compositional data): total-sum scaling then centered log-ratio. TSS+ILR: isometric log-ratio. logrelative: log relative abundance.

coda_occupancy.description: Minimum number of samples a feature must be present in (occupancy filter). Features present in fewer samples are removed.

coda_top_n.description: Retain only the top N most abundant features (by total count across samples) for modelling.

coda_lambda.description: GLMNET regularization parameter selection. 'lambda.min': minimize cross-validation error (less penalization, more features). 'lambda.1se': within one standard error of minimum (more penalization, sparser model).

coda_alpha.description: GLMNET mixing parameter. 0 = ridge regression (L2 penalty). 1 = lasso (L1 penalty, default). 0.5 = elastic net (mix of L1 and L2).

coda_binary_outcome.description: If true, auto-detect binary covariates and fit a logistic CODA-GLMNET. If false, all covariates are treated as continuous.

environmental_covariates.description: REQUIRED. Comma-separated list of metadata column names to use as response variables in CODA-GLMNET models. A separate model is fitted per group × covariate combination.

covariates_global.description: If true, fit a single model across all samples combined rather than per group. Useful when group sample sizes are too small for per-group modelling.

output_options.title: Output Options
output_options.description: Additional output formats produced after all analyses complete.

merge_parquet.description: Merge all output CSVs into a single Parquet file with analysis and table metadata columns.
merge_parquet.help_text: Writes linear_modelling_{label}.parquet to output_dir. Filter by 'analysis' and 'table' columns downstream.

dependent_csv.description: Path to CSV file containing the dependent variable (e.g., alpha diversity metrics output). Leave empty to read the dependent variable from meta_table instead (set dependent_source='metadata').

dependent_variable.description: Column name of the dependent (response) variable. Must exist in dependent_csv (if dependent_source=csv) or meta_table (if dependent_source=metadata).

dependent_source.description: Source for the dependent variable. 'csv': read from dependent_csv file (e.g. alpha diversity pipeline output). 'metadata': read directly from a column in meta_table.

explanatory_variables.description: REQUIRED. Comma-separated list of metadata column names to use as candidate predictors in subset regression.

regression_method.description: Subset selection algorithm passed to regsubsets(). 'exhaustive': all 2^p subsets (use only for small p). 'forward': sequential addition. 'backward': sequential removal. 'seqrep': sequential replacement.

test_method.description: Criterion for selecting the best model size. 'cv': k-fold cross-validation RMSE (use cv_folds to set k). 'aic': Akaike Information Criterion. 'bic': Bayesian Information Criterion.

cv_folds.description: Number of folds for cross-validation (only used when test_method='cv').

scale_predictors.description: If true, standardize (z-score) all numeric predictors before subset regression. Recommended for comparing coefficients across variables on different scales.

really_big.description: Pass really.big=TRUE to regsubsets(). Required when the number of predictors is large (>50) and regression_method='exhaustive'. Use with caution — computation time grows exponentially.
